title: Revalidate proper-source subgradients and convex restriction contracts
head: codex/research-online-subgradient-basic-migration

Definition2.20 explicitly restricts subgradients to proper functions. The shared SourceSubdifferential predicate also accepts generic EReal functions; this packet makes that wider library scope explicit and faithfully maps the proper specialization, required adjacent domain observation and Theorem2.21 on frozen Orabona v10 printed16-17/PDF28-29.

The actual finite-global-witness proof produces support-point domain membership and exactly yields dom-subdifferential inclusion/outside-domain emptiness. It drops source convexity, a stronger result rather than identical assumptions. Generic bottom points and identically-top functions can admit every vector as a support; properness is necessary for this source specialization. Theorem2.21 uses globally real f, convex V and global supports at every point of V, tested at every ambient y. Support existence is the printed hypothesis. Nonnegative weighted supports including0/1 and actual inner cancellation produce ConvexOn. The arbitrary real-inner-product scope generalizes finite Euclidean source; ambient E has zero/nonempty, V may be empty, no CompleteSpace/FiniteDimensional premise.
